#. Content of the 'Help Text' (HTML) field in DocType 'Process Statement Of
#. Accounts'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/process_statement_of_accounts/process_statement_of_accounts.json
#, python-format
msgid "<br>\n"
"<h4>Note</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"You can use <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja tags</a> in <b>Subject</b> and <b>Body</b> fields for dynamic values.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    All fields in this doctype are available under the <b>doc</b> object and all fields for the customer to whom the mail will go to is available under the  <b>customer</b> object.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Examples</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Subject</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Statement Of Accounts for {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Body</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Hello {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>PFA your Statement Of Accounts from {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"
msgstr "<br>\n"
"<h4>Напомена</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"Можете користити <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja ознаке</a> у пољима<b>Предмет</b> и <b>Текст</b> за динамичке вредности.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    Сва поља у овој врсти DocType су доступни под <b>доц</b> објектом, а сва поља купца коме ће имејл бити послат доступна су под  <b>купац</b> објектом.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Примери</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Наслов</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Извод ставки за {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Текст</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Здраво {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>u прилогу је извештај о рачунима од {{ doc.from_date }} до {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"

#. Content of the 'about' (HTML) field in DocType 'Product Bundle'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/product_bundle/product_bundle.json
msgid "<h3>About Product Bundle</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Aggregate group of <b>Items</b> into another <b>Item</b>. This is useful if you are bundling a certain <b>Items</b> into a package and you maintain stock of the packed <b>Items</b> and not the aggregate <b>Item</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>The package <b>Item</b> will have <code>Is Stock Item</code> as <b>No</b> and <code>Is Sales Item</code> as <b>Yes</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Example:</h4>\n"
"<p>If you are selling Laptops and Backpacks separately and have a special price if the customer buys both, then the Laptop + Backpack will be a new Product Bundle Item.</p>"
msgstr "<h3>О пакету производа</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Агрегатна група <b>ставки</b> у другој <b>ставци</b>. Ово је корисно уколико групишете одређене <b>ставке</b> у пакет и одржавате стање залихе запакованих <b>ставки</b>, а не агрегатне <b>ставке</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>Пакетне <b>ставке</b> ће имати <code>Ставка залиха</code> као <b>Не</b> и <code>Ставка продаје</code> као <b>Да</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Пример:</h4>\n"
"<p>Ако продајте лаптопове и рачунаре одвојено и имате посебну цену ако купац набави обе ставке, онда ће лаптоп + ранац бити нови пакет производа</p>"

#. Content of the 'Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Currency Exchange Settings'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/currency_exchange_settings/currency_exchange_settings.json
msgid "<h3>Currency Exchange Settings Help</h3>\n"
"<p>There are 3 variables that could be used within the endpoint, result key and in values of the parameter.</p>\n"
"<p>Exchange rate between {from_currency} and {to_currency} on {transaction_date} is fetched by the API.</p>\n"
"<p>Example: If your endpoint is exchange.com/2021-08-01, then, you will have to input exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"
msgstr "<h3>Помоћ за подешавање конверзија валуте</h3>\n"
"<p>Постоје 3 променљиве које се могу користити унутар endpoint-а, резултирајућег кључа и у вредностима параметара.</p>\n"
"<p>Девизни курс између {from_currency} и {to_currency} на {transaction_date} се преузима путем API-ја.</p>\n"
"<p>Пример: Уколико је Ваш endpoint exchange.com/2021-08-01, онда је неопходно да унесете exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"

#. Content of the 'Body and Closing Text Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Dunning
#. Letter Text'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/dunning_letter_text/dunning_letter_text.json
msgid "<h4>Body Text and Closing Text Example</h4>\n\n"
"<div>We have noticed that you have not yet paid invoice {{sales_invoice}} for {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. This is a friendly reminder that the invoice was due on {{due_date}}. Please pay the amount due immediately to avoid any further dunning cost.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your template are the fields in the document. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Пример резимеа и закључка</h4>\n\n"
"<div>Примили смо обавештење да још нисте уплатили фактуру {{sales_invoice}} за {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. Обавештавамо Вас да је фактура доспела {{due_date}}. Молимо Вас да без одлагања извршите плаћање доспелог износа како бисте избегли додатне трошкове по основу опомене.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>Како добити називе поља</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Називе поља која можете користити у шаблону су поља у документу. Можете сазнати која су поља у било којем документу путем Подешавање &gt; Прилагодите преглед форме и одабиром врсте документа (нпр. Излазна фактура)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Шаблони</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Шаблони се праве користећи Jinja језик. Да бисте сазнали више о Jinja језику,<a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">прочитајте ову документацију</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'Contract Template Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Contract
#. Template'
#: erpnext/crm/doctype/contract_template/contract_template.json
msgid "<h4>Contract Template Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Contract for Customer {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Valid From : {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Valid To : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The field names you can use in your Contract Template are the fields in the Contract for which you are creating the template. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Contract)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Пример шаблона уговора</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Купопродајни уговор са {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Важи од: {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Важи до : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Како добити називе поља</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Називе поља која можете добити у шаблону уговора су поља у уговору за који правите шаблон. Можете сазнати која су поља у било којем документу путем Подешавање &gt; Прилагодите преглед форме и одабиром врсте документа (нпр. Уговор)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Шаблони</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Шаблони се праве користећи Jinja језик. Да бисте сазнали више о Jinja језику, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">прочитајте ову документацију</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'Terms and Conditions Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Terms
#. and Conditions'
#: erpnext/setup/doctype/terms_and_conditions/terms_and_conditions.json
msgid "<h4>Standard Terms and Conditions Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Delivery Terms for Order number {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Order Date : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Expected Delivery Date : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your email template are the fields in the document from which you are sending the email. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Пример стандардних услова и одредби</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Услови испоруке за наруџбину {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Датум наруџбине : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Очекивани датум испоруке : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Како добити називе поља</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Називе поља која можете користити у шаблону имејла су поља у документу из којег шаљете имејл. Можете сазнати која су поља у било којем документу путем Подешавање &gt; Прилагодите преглед форме и одабиром врсте документа (нпр. Излазна фактура)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Шаблони</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Шаблони се праве користећи Jinja језик. Да бисте сазнали више о Jinja језику, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">прочитајте ову документацију</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'html_llwp' (HTML) field in DocType 'Request for Quotation'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/request_for_quotation/request_for_quotation.json
msgid "<p>In your <b>Email Template</b>, you can use the following special variables:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ update_password_link }}</code>: A link where your supplier can set a new password to log into your portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: A link to this RFQ in your supplier portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: The company name of your supplier.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: The contact person of your supplier.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Your full name.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Apart from these, you can access all values in this RFQ, like <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> or <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"
msgstr "<p>У Вашем <b>Имејл шаблону</b>, можете да користите следеће специјалне променљиве:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ update_password_link }}</code>: Линк где Ваш добављач може поставити нову лозинку за пријаву на Ваш портал\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: Линк ка овом захтеву за понуду на порталу добављача.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: Назив компаније добављача.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: Контакт особа добављача.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Ваше пуно име и презиме.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Поред ових, можете приступити свим вредностима у захтеву као што је <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> или <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"

#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/bank_clearance/bank_clearance.py:116
msgid "<p>Please correct the following row(s):</p><ul>"
msgstr "<p>Молимо Вас да исправите следеће редове:</p><ul>"

msgid "<p>Posting Date {0} cannot be before Purchase Order date for the following:</p><ul>"
msgstr "<p>Датум књижења {0} не може бити пре датума набавне поруџбине за следеће:</p><ul>"

#: erpnext/stock/doctype/stock_settings/stock_settings.js:69
msgid "<p>Price List Rate has not been set as editable in Selling Settings. In this scenario, setting <strong>Update Price List Based On</strong> to <strong>Price List Rate</strong> will prevent auto-updation of Item Price.</p>Are you sure you want to continue?"
msgstr "<p>Цена из ценовника није подешена као измењива у подешавању продаје. У овом случају, подешавање опције <strong>Ажурирај ценовник на основу</strong> на <strong>Основна цена у ценовнику</strong> ће онемогућити аутоматско ажурирање цене ставке</p>Да ли сте сигурни да желите да наставите?"

#: erpnext/controllers/accounts_controller.py:2195
msgid "<p>To allow over-billing, please set allowance in Accounts Settings.</p>"
msgstr "<p>Да бисте дозволили прекомерно фактурисање, подесите дозвољени износ у подешавањима рачуна.</p>"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Gateway
#. Account'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_gateway_account/payment_gateway_account.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Thank You for being a part of {{ doc.company }}! We hope you are enjoying the service.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Please find enclosed the E Bill statement. The outstanding amount is {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; We don't want you to be spending time running around in order to pay for your Bill.<br>After all, life is beautiful and the time you have in hand should be spent to enjoy it!<br>So here are our little ways to help you get more time for life! &lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Пример поруке</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;п&gt; Хвала Вам што сте део {{ doc.company }}! Надамо се да сте задовољни услугом.&lt;/п&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;п&gt; Достављамо Вам електронску фактуру. Преостали износ за уплату је {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/п&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;п&gt; Не желимо да трошите време трчећи около како бисте платили свој рачун<br>На крају крајева, живот треба да буде леп, а време треба да проведете уживајући у њему!<br>Због тога су овде наши мали начини да Вам помогнемо да добијете више времена за уживање!&lt;/п&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; Кликните овде да бисте платили &lt;/а&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Request'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_request/payment_request.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Dear {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Requesting payment for {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Пример поруке</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;п&gt;Поштовани/а {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Захтев за уплату {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} у износу од {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; Кликните овде да бисте платили &lt;/а&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

#: erpnext/stock/doctype/inventory_dimension/inventory_dimension.json
msgid "<table class=\"table table-bordered table-condensed\">\n"
"<thead>\n"
"  <tr>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Child Document</th>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Non Child Document</th>\n"
"   </tr>\n"
"</thead>\n"
"<tbody>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                  <p> To access parent document field use parent.fieldname and to access child table document field use doc.fieldname </p>\n\n"
"         </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                    <p>To access document field use doc.fieldname </p>\n"
"         </td>\n"
"</tr>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"        <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Example: </b> parent.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.item_code == \"Test\" </p>\n\n"
"        </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Example: </b> doc.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.purpose == \"Manufacture\"</p>    \n"
"          </td>\n"
"</tr>\n\n"
"</tbody>\n"
"</table>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"
msgstr "<table class=\"table table-bordered table-condensed\">\n"
"<thead>\n"
"  <tr>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Зависни документ</th>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Самостални документ</th>\n"
"   </tr>\n"
"</thead>\n"
"<tbody>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                  <p> Да бисте приступили пољу матични документ користите parent.fieldname, да бисте приступили пољу зависне табеле користите doc.fieldname </p>\n\n"
"         </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                    <p>Да бисте приступили пољу документа користите doc.fieldname </p>\n"
"         </td>\n"
"</tr>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"        <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Пример: </b> parent.doctype == \"Улаз у складиште\" and doc.item_code == \"Тест\" </p>\n\n"
"        </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Пример: </b> doc.doctype == \"Улаз у складиште\" and doc.purpose == \"Производња\"</p>    \n"
"          </td>\n"
"</tr>\n\n"
"</tbody>\n"
"</table>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"

#. Content of the 'Help Text' (HTML) field in DocType 'Process Statement Of
#. Accounts'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/process_statement_of_accounts/process_statement_of_accounts.json
#, python-format
msgid "<br>\n"
"<h4>Note</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"You can use <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja tags</a> in <b>Subject</b> and <b>Body</b> fields for dynamic values.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    All fields in this doctype are available under the <b>doc</b> object and all fields for the customer to whom the mail will go to is available under the  <b>customer</b> object.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Examples</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Subject</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Statement Of Accounts for {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Body</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Hello {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>PFA your Statement Of Accounts from {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"
msgstr "<br>\n"
"<h4>Napomena</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"Možete koristiti <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja oznake</a> u poljima<b>Predmet</b> i <b>Tekst</b> za dinamičke vrednosti.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    Sva polja u ovoj vrsti DocType su dostupni pod <b>doc</b> objektom, a sva polja kupca kome će imejl biti poslat dostupna su pod  <b>kupac</b> objektom.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Primeri</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Naslov</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Izvod stavki za {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Tekst</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Zdravo {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>u prilogu je izveštaj o računima od {{ doc.from_date }} do {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"

#. Content of the 'about' (HTML) field in DocType 'Product Bundle'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/product_bundle/product_bundle.json
msgid "<h3>About Product Bundle</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Aggregate group of <b>Items</b> into another <b>Item</b>. This is useful if you are bundling a certain <b>Items</b> into a package and you maintain stock of the packed <b>Items</b> and not the aggregate <b>Item</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>The package <b>Item</b> will have <code>Is Stock Item</code> as <b>No</b> and <code>Is Sales Item</code> as <b>Yes</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Example:</h4>\n"
"<p>If you are selling Laptops and Backpacks separately and have a special price if the customer buys both, then the Laptop + Backpack will be a new Product Bundle Item.</p>"
msgstr "<h3>O paketu proizvoda</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Agregatna grupa <b>stavki</b> u drugoj <b>stavci</b>. Ovo je korisno ukoliko grupišete određene <b>stavke</b> u paket i održavate stanje zalihe zapakovanih <b>stavki</b>, a ne agregatne <b>stavke</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>Paketne <b>stavke</b> će imati <code>Stavka zaliha</code> kao <b>Ne</b> i <code>Stavka prodaje</code> kao <b>Da</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Primer:</h4>\n"
"<p>Ako prodajte laptopove i računare odvojeno i imate posebnu cenu ako kupac nabavi obe stavke, onda će laptop + ranac biti novi paket proizvoda</p>"

#. Content of the 'Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Currency Exchange Settings'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/currency_exchange_settings/currency_exchange_settings.json
msgid "<h3>Currency Exchange Settings Help</h3>\n"
"<p>There are 3 variables that could be used within the endpoint, result key and in values of the parameter.</p>\n"
"<p>Exchange rate between {from_currency} and {to_currency} on {transaction_date} is fetched by the API.</p>\n"
"<p>Example: If your endpoint is exchange.com/2021-08-01, then, you will have to input exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"
msgstr "<h3>Pomoć za podešavanje konverzija valute</h3>\n"
"<p>Postoje 3 promenljive koje se mogu koristiti unutar endpoint-a, rezultirajućeg ključa i u vrednostima parametara.</p>\n"
"<p>Devizni kurs između {from_currency} i {to_currency} na {transaction_date} se preuzima putem API-ja.</p>\n"
"<p>Primer: Ukoliko je Vaš endpoint exchange.com/2024-08-01, onda je neophodno da unesete exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"

#. Content of the 'Body and Closing Text Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Dunning
#. Letter Text'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/dunning_letter_text/dunning_letter_text.json
msgid "<h4>Body Text and Closing Text Example</h4>\n\n"
"<div>We have noticed that you have not yet paid invoice {{sales_invoice}} for {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. This is a friendly reminder that the invoice was due on {{due_date}}. Please pay the amount due immediately to avoid any further dunning cost.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your template are the fields in the document. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Primer rezimea i zaključka</h4>\n\n"
"<div>Primili smo obaveštenje da još niste uplatili fakturu {{sales_invoice}} za {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. Obaveštavamo Vas da je faktura dospela {{due_date}}. Molimo Vas da bez odlaganja izvršite plaćanje dospelog iznosa kako biste izbegli dodatne troškove po osnovu opomene.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>Kako dobiti nazive polja</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Nazive polja koja možete koristiti u šablonu su polja u dokumentu. Možete saznati koja su polja u bilo kojem dokumentu putem Podešavanje &gt; Prilagodite pregled forme i odabirom vrste dokumenta (npr. Izlazna faktura)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Šabloni</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Šabloni se prave koristeći Jinja jezik. Da biste saznali više o Jinja jeziku,<a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">pročitajte ovu dokumentaciju</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'Contract Template Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Contract
#. Template'
#: erpnext/crm/doctype/contract_template/contract_template.json
msgid "<h4>Contract Template Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Contract for Customer {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Valid From : {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Valid To : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The field names you can use in your Contract Template are the fields in the Contract for which you are creating the template. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Contract)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Primer šablona ugovora</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Kupoprodajni ugovor sa {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Važi od: {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Važi do : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Kako dobiti nazive polja</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Nazive polja koja možete dobiti u šablonu ugovora su polja u ugovoru za koji pravite šablon. Možete saznati koja su polja u bilo kojem dokumentu putem Podešavanje &gt; Prilagodite pregled forme i odabirom vrste dokumenta (npr. Ugovor)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Šabloni</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Šabloni se prave koristeći Jinja jezik. Da biste saznali više o Jinja jeziku, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">pročitajte ovu dokumentaciju</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'Terms and Conditions Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Terms
#. and Conditions'
#: erpnext/setup/doctype/terms_and_conditions/terms_and_conditions.json
msgid "<h4>Standard Terms and Conditions Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Delivery Terms for Order number {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Order Date : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Expected Delivery Date : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your email template are the fields in the document from which you are sending the email. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Primer standardnih uslova i odredbi</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Uslovi isporuke za narudžbinu {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Datum narudžbine : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Očekivani datum isporuke : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Kako dobiti nazive polja</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Nazive polja koja možete koristiti u šablonu imejla su polja u dokumentu iz kojeg šaljete imejl. Možete saznati koja su polja u bilo kojem dokumentu putem Podešavanje &gt; Prilagodite pregled forme i odabirom vrste dokumenta (e.g. Izlazna faktura)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Šabloni</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Šabloni se prave koristeći Jinja jezik. Da biste saznali više o Jinja jeziku, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">pročitajte ovu dokumentaciju</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'html_llwp' (HTML) field in DocType 'Request for Quotation'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/request_for_quotation/request_for_quotation.json
msgid "<p>In your <b>Email Template</b>, you can use the following special variables:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ update_password_link }}</code>: A link where your supplier can set a new password to log into your portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: A link to this RFQ in your supplier portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: The company name of your supplier.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: The contact person of your supplier.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Your full name.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Apart from these, you can access all values in this RFQ, like <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> or <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"
msgstr "<p>U Vašem <b>Imejl šablonu</b>, možete da koristite sledeće specijalne promenljive:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ update_password_link }}</code>: Link gde Vaš dobavljač može postaviti novu lozinku za prijavu na Vaš portal\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: Link ka ovom zahtevu za ponudu na portalu dobavljača.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: Naziv kompanije dobavljača.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: Kontakt osoba dobavljača.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Vaše puno ime i prezime.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Pored ovih, možete pristupiti svim vrednostima u zahtevu kao što je <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> ili <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"

#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/bank_clearance/bank_clearance.py:116
msgid "<p>Please correct the following row(s):</p><ul>"
msgstr "<p>Molimo Vas da ispravite sledeće redove:</p><ul>"

msgid "<p>Posting Date {0} cannot be before Purchase Order date for the following:</p><ul>"

#: erpnext/stock/doctype/stock_settings/stock_settings.js:69
msgid "<p>Price List Rate has not been set as editable in Selling Settings. In this scenario, setting <strong>Update Price List Based On</strong> to <strong>Price List Rate</strong> will prevent auto-updation of Item Price.</p>Are you sure you want to continue?"
msgstr "<p>Cena iz cenovnika nije podešena kao izmenjiva u podešavanju prodaje. U ovom slučaju, podešavanje opcije <strong>Ažuriraj cenovnik na osnovu</strong> na <strong>Osnovna cena u cenovniku</strong> će onemogućiti automatsko ažuriranje cene stavke</p>Da li ste sigurni da želite da nastavite?"

#: erpnext/controllers/accounts_controller.py:2195
msgid "<p>To allow over-billing, please set allowance in Accounts Settings.</p>"
msgstr "<p>Da biste dozvolili prekomerno fakturisanje, podesite dozvoljeni iznos u podešavanjima računa.</p>"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Gateway
#. Account'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_gateway_account/payment_gateway_account.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Thank You for being a part of {{ doc.company }}! We hope you are enjoying the service.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Please find enclosed the E Bill statement. The outstanding amount is {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; We don't want you to be spending time running around in order to pay for your Bill.<br>After all, life is beautiful and the time you have in hand should be spent to enjoy it!<br>So here are our little ways to help you get more time for life! &lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Primer poruke</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Hvala Vam što ste deo {{ doc.company }}! Nadamo se da ste zadovoljni uslugom.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Dostavljamo Vam elektronsku fakturu. Preostali iznos za uplatu je {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Ne želimo da trošite vreme trčeći okolo kako biste platili svoj račun<br>Na kraju krajeva, život treba da bude lep, a vreme treba da provedete uživajući u njemu!<br>Zbog toga su ovde naši mali načini da Vam pomognemo da dobijete više vremena za uživanje!&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; Kliknite ovde da biste platili &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Request'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_request/payment_request.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Dear {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Requesting payment for {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Primer poruke</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Poštovani/a {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Zahtev za uplatu {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} u iznosu od {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; Kliknite ovde da biste platili &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

"   </tr>\n"
"</thead>\n"
"<tbody>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                  <p> To access parent document field use parent.fieldname and to access child table document field use doc.fieldname </p>\n\n"
"         </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                    <p>To access document field use doc.fieldname </p>\n"
"         </td>\n"
"</tr>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"        <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Example: </b> parent.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.item_code == \"Test\" </p>\n\n"
"        </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Example: </b> doc.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.purpose == \"Manufacture\"</p>    \n"
"          </td>\n"
"</tr>\n\n"
"</tbody>\n"
"</table>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"
msgstr "<table class=\"table table-bordered table-condensed\">\n"
"<thead>\n"
"  <tr>\n"

"</thead>\n"
"<tbody>\n"
"<tr>\n"

"                  <p> Da biste pristupili polju matični dokument koristite parent.fieldname, da biste pristupili polju zavisne tabele koristite doc.fieldname </p>\n\n"
"         </td>\n"

"         </td>\n"
"</tr>\n"

"        </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"

"</tbody>\n"
"</table>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"

#. Description of the 'Allow Purchase Order with Zero Quantity' (Check) field
#. in DocType 'Buying Settings'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/buying_settings/buying_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Purchase Orders with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."

#. Description of the 'Allow Quotation with Zero Quantity' (Check) field in
#. DocType 'Selling Settings'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/selling_settings/selling_settings.json

#: erpnext/buying/doctype/buying_settings/buying_settings.json

msgstr "Omogućava korisnicima da podnesu zahtev za ponudu sa nultom količinom. Korisno kada su cene fiksne, a količine nisu, na primer ugovori gde su cene unapred dogovorene, a količine nisu poznate."

#. Description of the 'Allow Sales Order with Zero Quantity' (Check) field in
#. DocType 'Selling Settings'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/selling_settings/selling_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Sales Orders with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."
msgstr "Omogućava korisnicima da podnesu prodajnu porudžbinu sa nultom količinom. Korisno kada su cene fiksne, a količine nisu, na primer ugovori gde su cene unapred dogovorene, a količine nisu poznate."

#. Description of the 'Allow Supplier Quotation with Zero Quantity' (Check)
#. field in DocType 'Buying Settings'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/buying_settings/buying_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Supplier Quotations with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."
msgstr "Omogućava korisnicima da podnesu ponudu dobavljača sa nultom količinom. Korisno kada su cene fiksne, a količine nisu, na primer ugovori gde su cene unapred dogovorene, a količine nisu poznate."

#. Content of the 'Help Text' (HTML) field in DocType 'Process Statement Of
#. Accounts'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/process_statement_of_accounts/process_statement_of_accounts.json
#, python-format
msgid "<br>\n"
"<h4>Note</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"You can use <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja tags</a> in <b>Subject</b> and <b>Body</b> fields for dynamic values.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    All fields in this doctype are available under the <b>doc</b> object and all fields for the customer to whom the mail will go to is available under the  <b>customer</b> object.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Examples</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Subject</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Statement Of Accounts for {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Body</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Hello {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>PFA your Statement Of Accounts from {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"
msgstr "<br>\n"
"<h4>Observera</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"Du kan använda <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja Taggar</a> i <b>Ämne</b> och <b> Huvudtext</b>-fält för dynamiska värden.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"     Alla fält i denna doctype är tillgängliga under <b>doc</b>-objekt och alla fält för kund som e-post meddelande går till är tillgängliga under <b>customer</b>-objekt.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Exempel</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% rå %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"     <li><b>Ämne</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Konto besked för {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"     <li><b>Huvudtext</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Hej {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>Kontoutdrag från {{ doc.from_date }} till {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></ li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"

#. Content of the 'about' (HTML) field in DocType 'Product Bundle'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/product_bundle/product_bundle.json
msgid "<h3>About Product Bundle</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Aggregate group of <b>Items</b> into another <b>Item</b>. This is useful if you are bundling a certain <b>Items</b> into a package and you maintain stock of the packed <b>Items</b> and not the aggregate <b>Item</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>The package <b>Item</b> will have <code>Is Stock Item</code> as <b>No</b> and <code>Is Sales Item</code> as <b>Yes</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Example:</h4>\n"
"<p>If you are selling Laptops and Backpacks separately and have a special price if the customer buys both, then the Laptop + Backpack will be a new Product Bundle Item.</p>"
msgstr "<h3>Om Artikel Paket</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Paketera grupp av <b>artiklar</b> till annan <b>Artikel</b>. Det är användbart om man paketerar vissa <b>Artiklar</b> i paket och har lager av packade <b>Artiklar</b> och inte paketarad <b>Artikel</b></b>.</b>Artikel kommer att ha <b>Artikel</b>. <code>Är Lager Artikel</code> som <b>Nej</b> och <code>Är Försäljning Artikel</code> som <b>Ja</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Exempel:</h4>\n"
"<p>Om man säljer bärbara datorer och ryggsäckar separat och har specialpris om kunder köper båda, så kommer det att vara bärbar dator + ryggsäck som paket artikel"

#. Content of the 'Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Currency Exchange Settings'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/currency_exchange_settings/currency_exchange_settings.json
msgid "<h3>Currency Exchange Settings Help</h3>\n"
"<p>There are 3 variables that could be used within the endpoint, result key and in values of the parameter.</p>\n"
"<p>Exchange rate between {from_currency} and {to_currency} on {transaction_date} is fetched by the API.</p>\n"
"<p>Example: If your endpoint is exchange.com/2021-08-01, then, you will have to input exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"
msgstr "<h3>Valutaväxling Inställningar Hjälp</h3>\n"
"<p>Det finns 3 variabler som kan användas av slutpunkt, resultat nyckel och i parameter värde.</p>\n"
"<p>Växelkurs mellan {from_currency} och {to_currency} {transaction_date} hämtas av API.</p>\n"
"<p>Exempel: Om slutpunkt är exchange.com/2021-08-01 måste du ange exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"

#. Content of the 'Body and Closing Text Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Dunning
#. Letter Text'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/dunning_letter_text/dunning_letter_text.json
msgid "<h4>Body Text and Closing Text Example</h4>\n\n"
"<div>We have noticed that you have not yet paid invoice {{sales_invoice}} for {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. This is a friendly reminder that the invoice was due on {{due_date}}. Please pay the amount due immediately to avoid any further dunning cost.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your template are the fields in the document. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Huvudtext och exempel på Avslutande Text</h4>\n\n"
"<div>Vi har märkt att ni ännu inte har betalat faktura {{sales_invoice}} för {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. Detta är en vänlig påminnelse om att fakturan var förfallen {{due_date}}. Vänligen betala förfallen belopp omedelbart för att undvika ytterligare kostnader.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>Hur får man fältnamn</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Fältnamn man kan använda i mall är fält i dokument. Du kan ta reda på fält namn för alla dokument via Inställningar &gt; Anpassa formulärvy och välj dokument typ (t.ex. Försäljning Faktura)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Mall</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Mallar kompileras med Jinja Templating Language. Om du vill veta mer om Jinja <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">läs denna dokumentation.</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'Contract Template Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Contract
#. Template'
#: erpnext/crm/doctype/contract_template/contract_template.json
msgid "<h4>Contract Template Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Contract for Customer {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Valid From : {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Valid To : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The field names you can use in your Contract Template are the fields in the Contract for which you are creating the template. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Contract)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Exempel på Avtal Mall</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Avtal för Kund {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Giltigt från: {{ start_date }}\n"
"-Gäller till: {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Hur får man fältnamn</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Fältnamn du kan använda i avtal mall är fält i avtal som du skapar mallen för. Du kan ta reda på fält namn för alla dokument via Inställningar &gt; Anpassa formulärvy  och välj dokument typ (t.ex. Avtal)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Mall</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Mallar kompileras med Jinja Templating Language. Om du vill veta mer om Jinja <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">läser du den här dokumentationen.</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'Terms and Conditions Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Terms
#. and Conditions'
#: erpnext/setup/doctype/terms_and_conditions/terms_and_conditions.json
msgid "<h4>Standard Terms and Conditions Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Delivery Terms for Order number {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Order Date : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Expected Delivery Date : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your email template are the fields in the document from which you are sending the email. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Exempel på Standard Villkor</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Leverans Villkor för Order Nummer {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Order Datum: {{ transaction_date }}\n"
"-Förväntat Leverans Datum: {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Hur hämtas fältnamn</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Fältnamn som kan användas i E-post Mall är fält i Dokument som man skickar E-post meddelande från. Man kan ta reda på fält namn för alla dokument via Inställning &gt; Anpassa Formulär Vy och välja Dokument Typ (t.ex. Försäljning Faktura)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Skriva Mallar</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Mallar kompileras med Jinja Mall Språk. Läs mer om Jinja dokumentation: <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\"></a></p>"

#. Content of the 'html_llwp' (HTML) field in DocType 'Request for Quotation'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/request_for_quotation/request_for_quotation.json
msgid "<p>In your <b>Email Template</b>, you can use the following special variables:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ update_password_link }}</code>: A link where your supplier can set a new password to log into your portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: A link to this RFQ in your supplier portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: The company name of your supplier.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: The contact person of your supplier.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Your full name.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Apart from these, you can access all values in this RFQ, like <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> or <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"
msgstr "<p>I <b>E-post Mall</b> kan följande specialvariabler användas:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
" <code>{{ update_password_link }} </code>: Länk där leverantör kan ange nytt lösenord för att logga in på leverantör portal.\n"
" </li>\n"
" <li>\n"
" <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: Länk till offert begäran på leverantör portal.\n"
" </li>\n"
" <li>\n"
" <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: Leverantör namn.\n"
" </li>\n"
" <li >\n"
" <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: Kontakt person för leverantör.\n"
" </li>\n"
" <li>\n"
" <code>{{ user_fullname } }</code>: Användarens fullständiga namn.\n"
" </li>\n"
" </ul>\n"
"<p>\n"
"</p>\n"
"<p>Förutom dessa kan man komma åt alla värden i offert begäran, som <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> eller <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"

msgid "<p>Price List Rate has not been set as editable in Selling Settings. In this scenario, setting <strong>Update Price List Based On</strong> to <strong>Price List Rate</strong> will prevent auto-updation of Item Price.</p>Are you sure you want to continue?"
msgstr "<p>Prislista Pris är inte angiven som redigerbart i Försäljning Inställningar. I det här scenariot kommer inställning <strong>Uppdatera Prislista Baserat På</strong> till <strong>Prislista Pris</strong> att förhindra automatisk uppdatering av artikel pris.</p>Är du säker på att du vill fortsätta?"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Gateway
#. Account'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_gateway_account/payment_gateway_account.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Thank You for being a part of {{ doc.company }}! We hope you are enjoying the service.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Please find enclosed the E Bill statement. The outstanding amount is {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; We don't want you to be spending time running around in order to pay for your Bill.<br>After all, life is beautiful and the time you have in hand should be spent to enjoy it!<br>So here are our little ways to help you get more time for life! &lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Meddelande Exempel</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Tack för att ni är en del av {{ doc.company }}! Vi hoppas att ni gillar tjänst.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Vänligen se bifogat E-faktura. Utestående belopp är {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Vi vill inte att ni ska spendera tid med att springa runt för att betala faktura.<br>Livet är trots allt vackert och den tid man har bör spenderas för att njuta av livet!<br>Så här är våra små sätt att hjälpa er att få mer tid för livet! &lt; /p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; klicka här för att betala &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Request'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_request/payment_request.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Dear {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Requesting payment for {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Meddelande Exempel</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Hej {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Begär betalning för {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} för {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; klicka här för att betala &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

#. Content of the 'html_19' (HTML) field in DocType 'Inventory Dimension'
#: erpnext/stock/doctype/inventory_dimension/inventory_dimension.json
msgid "<table class=\"table table-bordered table-condensed\">\n"
"<thead>\n"
"  <tr>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Child Document</th>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Non Child Document</th>\n"
"   </tr>\n"
"</thead>\n"
"<tbody>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                  <p> To access parent document field use parent.fieldname and to access child table document field use doc.fieldname </p>\n\n"
"         </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                    <p>To access document field use doc.fieldname </p>\n"
"         </td>\n"
"</tr>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"        <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Example: </b> parent.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.item_code == \"Test\" </p>\n\n"
"        </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Example: </b> doc.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.purpose == \"Manufacture\"</p>    \n"
"          </td>\n"
"</tr>\n\n"
"</tbody>\n"
"</table>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"
msgstr "<thead>\n"
"  <tr>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Underordnad Dokument</th>\n"
"         <th class=\"table-sr\" style=\"width: 50%;\">Överordnad Dokument</th>\n"
"   </tr>\n"
"</thead>\n"
"<tbody>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                  <p>För att komma åt överordnad dokument fält använd parent.fieldname och för att komma åt underordnad dokument fält använd doc.fieldname </p>\n\n"
"         </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                    <p>För att komma åt dokument fält använd doc.fieldname </p>\n"
"         </td>\n"
"</tr>\n"
"<tr>\n"
"        <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Exampel: </b> parent.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.item_code == \"Test\" </p>\n\n"
"        </td>\n"
"         <td>\n"
"                   <p><b>Exampel: </b> doc.doctype == \"Stock Entry\" and doc.purpose == \"Produktion\"</p>    \n"
"          </td>\n"
"</tr>\n\n"
"</tbody>\n"
"</table>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n"

#. Description of the 'Enable Stock Reservation' (Check) field in DocType
#. 'Stock Settings'
#: erpnext/stock/doctype/stock_settings/stock_settings.json

msgstr "Tillåter reservation av specifierad artikel kvantitet för angiven order."

#. Description of the 'Allow Purchase Order with Zero Quantity' (Check) field
#. in DocType 'Buying Settings'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/buying_settings/buying_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Purchase Orders with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."
msgstr "Tillåter användare att godkänna Inköp Ordrar med noll kvantitet. Användbart när priserna är fasta men kvantiteter inte är. T. ex. Pris Avtal."

#. Description of the 'Allow Quotation with Zero Quantity' (Check) field in
#. DocType 'Selling Settings'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/selling_settings/selling_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Quotations with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."
msgstr "Tillåter användare att godkänna Offerter med noll kvantitet. Användbart när priserna är fasta men kvantiteter inte är. T. ex. Pris Avtal."

#. Description of the 'Allow Request for Quotation with Zero Quantity' (Check)
#. field in DocType 'Buying Settings'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/buying_settings/buying_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Request for Quotations with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."
msgstr "Tillåter användare att godkänna Offert Begäran med noll kvantitet. Användbart när priserna är fasta men kvantiteter inte är. T. ex. Pris Avtal."

#. Description of the 'Allow Sales Order with Zero Quantity' (Check) field in
#. DocType 'Selling Settings'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/selling_settings/selling_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Sales Orders with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."
msgstr "Tillåter användare att godkänna Försäljning Ordrar med noll kvantitet. Användbart när priserna är fasta men kvantiteter inte är. T. ex. Pris Avtal."

#. Description of the 'Allow Supplier Quotation with Zero Quantity' (Check)
#. field in DocType 'Buying Settings'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/buying_settings/buying_settings.json
msgid "Allows users to submit Supplier Quotations with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts."
msgstr "Tillåter användare att godkänna Leverantör Offerter med noll kvantitet. Användbart när priserna är fasta men kvantiteter inte är. T. ex. Pris Avtal."

"You can use <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja tags</a> in <b>Subject</b> and <b>Body</b> fields for dynamic values.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    All fields in this doctype are available under the <b>doc</b> object and all fields for the customer to whom the mail will go to is available under the  <b>customer</b> object.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Examples</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Subject</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Statement Of Accounts for {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Body</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Hello {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>PFA your Statement Of Accounts from {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'about' (HTML) field in DocType 'Product Bundle'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/product_bundle/product_bundle.json
msgid "<h3>About Product Bundle</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Aggregate group of <b>Items</b> into another <b>Item</b>. This is useful if you are bundling a certain <b>Items</b> into a package and you maintain stock of the packed <b>Items</b> and not the aggregate <b>Item</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>The package <b>Item</b> will have <code>Is Stock Item</code> as <b>No</b> and <code>Is Sales Item</code> as <b>Yes</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Example:</h4>\n"
"<p>If you are selling Laptops and Backpacks separately and have a special price if the customer buys both, then the Laptop + Backpack will be a new Product Bundle Item.</p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Currency Exchange Settings'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/currency_exchange_settings/currency_exchange_settings.json
msgid "<h3>Currency Exchange Settings Help</h3>\n"
"<p>There are 3 variables that could be used within the endpoint, result key and in values of the parameter.</p>\n"
"<p>Exchange rate between {from_currency} and {to_currency} on {transaction_date} is fetched by the API.</p>\n"
"<p>Example: If your endpoint is exchange.com/2021-08-01, then, you will have to input exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Body and Closing Text Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Dunning
#. Letter Text'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/dunning_letter_text/dunning_letter_text.json
msgid "<h4>Body Text and Closing Text Example</h4>\n\n"
"<div>We have noticed that you have not yet paid invoice {{sales_invoice}} for {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. This is a friendly reminder that the invoice was due on {{due_date}}. Please pay the amount due immediately to avoid any further dunning cost.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your template are the fields in the document. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Contract Template Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Contract
#. Template'
#: erpnext/crm/doctype/contract_template/contract_template.json
msgid "<h4>Contract Template Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Contract for Customer {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Valid From : {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Valid To : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The field names you can use in your Contract Template are the fields in the Contract for which you are creating the template. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Contract)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Terms and Conditions Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Terms
#. and Conditions'
#: erpnext/setup/doctype/terms_and_conditions/terms_and_conditions.json
msgid "<h4>Standard Terms and Conditions Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Delivery Terms for Order number {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Order Date : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Expected Delivery Date : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your email template are the fields in the document from which you are sending the email. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr ""

msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"

"&lt;p&gt; Please find enclosed the E Bill statement. The outstanding amount is {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"

#. Content of the 'Help Text' (HTML) field in DocType 'Process Statement Of
#. Accounts'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/process_statement_of_accounts/process_statement_of_accounts.json
#, python-format
msgid "<br>\n"
"<h4>Note</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"You can use <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja tags</a> in <b>Subject</b> and <b>Body</b> fields for dynamic values.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    All fields in this doctype are available under the <b>doc</b> object and all fields for the customer to whom the mail will go to is available under the  <b>customer</b> object.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Examples</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Subject</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Statement Of Accounts for {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Body</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Hello {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>PFA your Statement Of Accounts from {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'about' (HTML) field in DocType 'Product Bundle'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/product_bundle/product_bundle.json
msgid "<h3>About Product Bundle</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Aggregate group of <b>Items</b> into another <b>Item</b>. This is useful if you are bundling a certain <b>Items</b> into a package and you maintain stock of the packed <b>Items</b> and not the aggregate <b>Item</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>The package <b>Item</b> will have <code>Is Stock Item</code> as <b>No</b> and <code>Is Sales Item</code> as <b>Yes</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Example:</h4>\n"
"<p>If you are selling Laptops and Backpacks separately and have a special price if the customer buys both, then the Laptop + Backpack will be a new Product Bundle Item.</p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Currency Exchange Settings'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/currency_exchange_settings/currency_exchange_settings.json
msgid "<h3>Currency Exchange Settings Help</h3>\n"
"<p>There are 3 variables that could be used within the endpoint, result key and in values of the parameter.</p>\n"
"<p>Exchange rate between {from_currency} and {to_currency} on {transaction_date} is fetched by the API.</p>\n"
"<p>Example: If your endpoint is exchange.com/2021-08-01, then, you will have to input exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Body and Closing Text Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Dunning
#. Letter Text'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/dunning_letter_text/dunning_letter_text.json
msgid "<h4>Body Text and Closing Text Example</h4>\n\n"
"<div>We have noticed that you have not yet paid invoice {{sales_invoice}} for {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. This is a friendly reminder that the invoice was due on {{due_date}}. Please pay the amount due immediately to avoid any further dunning cost.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your template are the fields in the document. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Contract Template Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Contract
#. Template'
#: erpnext/crm/doctype/contract_template/contract_template.json
msgid "<h4>Contract Template Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Contract for Customer {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Valid From : {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Valid To : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The field names you can use in your Contract Template are the fields in the Contract for which you are creating the template. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Contract)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr ""

#. Content of the 'Terms and Conditions Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Terms
#. and Conditions'
#: erpnext/setup/doctype/terms_and_conditions/terms_and_conditions.json
msgid "<h4>Standard Terms and Conditions Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Delivery Terms for Order number {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Order Date : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Expected Delivery Date : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your email template are the fields in the document from which you are sending the email. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr ""

"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: A link to this RFQ in your supplier portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: The company name of your supplier.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: The contact person of your supplier.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Your full name.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Apart from these, you can access all values in this RFQ, like <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> or <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"

msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"

"&lt;p&gt; Please find enclosed the E Bill statement. The outstanding amount is {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; We don't want you to be spending time running around in order to pay for your Bill.<br>After all, life is beautiful and the time you have in hand should be spent to enjoy it!<br>So here are our little ways to help you get more time for life! &lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

#. Content of the 'Help Text' (HTML) field in DocType 'Process Statement Of
#. Accounts'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/process_statement_of_accounts/process_statement_of_accounts.json
#, python-format
msgid "<br>\n"
"<h4>Note</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"You can use <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja tags</a> in <b>Subject</b> and <b>Body</b> fields for dynamic values.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    All fields in this doctype are available under the <b>doc</b> object and all fields for the customer to whom the mail will go to is available under the  <b>customer</b> object.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Examples</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Subject</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Statement Of Accounts for {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Body</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Hello {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>PFA your Statement Of Accounts from {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }}.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"
msgstr "<br>\n"
"<h4>Not</h4>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"<li>\n"
"Dinamik değerler için <b>Konu</b> ve <b>Gövde</b> alanlarında <a href=\"https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/2.11.x/\" target=\"_blank\">Jinja etiketlerini</a> kullanabilirsiniz.\n"
"</li><li>\n"
"    Bu belge türündeki tüm alanlar <b>belge</b> nesnesi altında ve postanın gideceği müşteriye ait tüm alanlar  <b>müşteri</b> nesnesi altında mevcuttur.\n"
"</li></ul>\n"
"<h4> Örnekler</h4>\n"
"<!-- {% raw %} -->\n"
"<ul>\n"
"    <li><b>Konu</b>:<br><br><pre><code>Hesap Özeti {{ customer.customer_name }}</code></pre><br></li>\n"
"    <li><b>Gövde</b>: <br><br>\n"
"<pre><code>Merhaba {{ customer.customer_name }},<br>Hesap Özetinizi {{ doc.from_date }} 'den {{ doc.to_date }}'e kadar PFA yapın.</code> </pre></li>\n"
"</ul>\n"
"<!-- {% endraw %} -->"

#. Content of the 'about' (HTML) field in DocType 'Product Bundle'
#: erpnext/selling/doctype/product_bundle/product_bundle.json
msgid "<h3>About Product Bundle</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Aggregate group of <b>Items</b> into another <b>Item</b>. This is useful if you are bundling a certain <b>Items</b> into a package and you maintain stock of the packed <b>Items</b> and not the aggregate <b>Item</b>.</p>\n"
"<p>The package <b>Item</b> will have <code>Is Stock Item</code> as <b>No</b> and <code>Is Sales Item</code> as <b>Yes</b>.</p>\n"
"<h4>Example:</h4>\n"
"<p>If you are selling Laptops and Backpacks separately and have a special price if the customer buys both, then the Laptop + Backpack will be a new Product Bundle Item.</p>"
msgstr "<h3>Ürün Paketi Hakkında</h3>\n\n"
"<p>Bir grup <b>Ürünü</b> başka bir Üründe toplar. Bu, belirli <b>Ürünleri</b> bir pakette topluyorsanız ve toplu <b>Ürünün</b> değil paketlenmiş <b>Ürünlerin</b> stokunu tutuyorsanız kullanışlıdır.</p>\n"
"<p>Paket <b>Ürünü</b> <code>Stok</code> Ürünü mü <b>Hayır</b> ve <code>Satış</code> Ürünü mü <b>Evet</b> olarak ayarlanacaktır.</p>\n"
"<h4>Örnek:</h4>\n"
"<p>Dizüstü Bilgisayarları ve Sırt Çantalarını ayrı ayrı satıyorsanız ve müşteri her ikisini de satın alırsa özel bir fiyatınız varsa, Dizüstü Bilgisayar + Sırt Çantası yeni bir Ürün Paketinin Ürünü olacaktır.</p>"

#. Content of the 'Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Currency Exchange Settings'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/currency_exchange_settings/currency_exchange_settings.json
msgid "<h3>Currency Exchange Settings Help</h3>\n"
"<p>There are 3 variables that could be used within the endpoint, result key and in values of the parameter.</p>\n"
"<p>Exchange rate between {from_currency} and {to_currency} on {transaction_date} is fetched by the API.</p>\n"
"<p>Example: If your endpoint is exchange.com/2021-08-01, then, you will have to input exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>"
msgstr "<h3>Döviz Kuru Ayarları Yardımı</h3>\n"
"<p>Son nokta, sonuç anahtarı ve parametre değerlerinde kullanılabilecek 3 değişken vardır.</p>\n"
"<p> {transaction_date} tarihinde {from_currency} ile {to_currency} arasındaki döviz kuru API tarafından alınır.</p>\n"
"<p>Örnek: Son noktanız exchange.com/2024-08-01 ise, exchange.com/{transaction_date}</p>girmeniz gerekecektir."

#. Content of the 'Body and Closing Text Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Dunning
#. Letter Text'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/dunning_letter_text/dunning_letter_text.json
msgid "<h4>Body Text and Closing Text Example</h4>\n\n"
"<div>We have noticed that you have not yet paid invoice {{sales_invoice}} for {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}. This is a friendly reminder that the invoice was due on {{due_date}}. Please pay the amount due immediately to avoid any further dunning cost.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your template are the fields in the document. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Gövde Metni ve Kapanış Metni Örneği</h4>\n\n"
"<div> {{frappe.db.get_value(\"Currency\", currency, \"symbol\")}} {{outstanding_amount}}için {{sales_invoice}} faturasını henüz ödemediğinizi fark ettik. Bu, faturanın {{due_date}}tarihinde ödenmesi gerektiğine dair dostane bir hatırlatmadır. Daha fazla ihtar masrafından kaçınmak için lütfen ödenmesi gereken tutarı derhal ödeyin.</div>\n\n"
"<h4>Alan adları nasıl alınır</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Şablonunuzda kullanabileceğiniz alan adları belgede yer alan alanlardır. Herhangi bir belgenin alanlarını Kurulum &gt; Form Görünümünü Özelleştir üzerinden ve belge türünü seçerek öğrenebilirsiniz (örn. Satış Faturası)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Şablonlama</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Şablonlar Jinja Templating Language kullanılarak derlenir. Jinja hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek için <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">bu belgeyi okuyun.</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'Contract Template Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Contract
#. Template'
#: erpnext/crm/doctype/contract_template/contract_template.json
msgid "<h4>Contract Template Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Contract for Customer {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Valid From : {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Valid To : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The field names you can use in your Contract Template are the fields in the Contract for which you are creating the template. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Contract)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Sözleşme Şablonu Örneği</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Müşteri için Sözleşme {{ party_name }}\n\n"
"-Geçerli Başlangıç : {{ start_date }} \n"
"-Geçerli Bitiş : {{ end_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Alan adları nasıl alınır</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Sözleşme Şablonunuzda kullanabileceğiniz alan adları, şablonunu oluşturduğunuz Sözleşmedeki alanlardır. Herhangi bir belgenin alanlarını Kurulum &gt; Form Görünümünü Özelleştir aracılığıyla ve belge türünü (örneğin Sözleşme) seçerek öğrenebilirsiniz</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Şablonlama</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Şablonlar Jinja Templating Language kullanılarak derlenir. Jinja hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek için <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">bu belgeyi okuyun</a>.</p>"

#. Content of the 'Terms and Conditions Help' (HTML) field in DocType 'Terms
#. and Conditions'
#: erpnext/setup/doctype/terms_and_conditions/terms_and_conditions.json
msgid "<h4>Standard Terms and Conditions Example</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Delivery Terms for Order number {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Order Date : {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Expected Delivery Date : {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>How to get fieldnames</h4>\n\n"
"<p>The fieldnames you can use in your email template are the fields in the document from which you are sending the email. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup &gt; Customize Form View and selecting the document type (e.g. Sales Invoice)</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Templating</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">read this documentation.</a></p>"
msgstr "<h4>Standart Şartlar ve Koşullar Örneği</h4>\n\n"
"<pre>Sipariş numarası için Teslimat Koşulları {{ name }}\n\n"
"-Sipariş Tarihi: {{ transaction_date }} \n"
"-Beklenen Teslimat Tarihi: {{ delivery_date }}\n"
"</pre>\n\n"
"<h4>Alan adları nasıl alınır</h4>\n\n"
"<p>E-posta şablonunuzda kullanabileceğiniz alan adları, e-postayı gönderdiğiniz belgedeki alanlardır. Herhangi bir belgenin alanlarını Kurulum &gt; Form Görünümünü Özelleştir ve belge türünü (örneğin Satış Faturası) seçerek bulabilirsiniz</p>\n\n"
"<h4>Şablonlama</h4>\n\n"
"<p>Şablonlar Jinja Şablonlama Dili kullanılarak derlenir. Jinja hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek için <a class=\"strong\" href=\"http://jinja.pocoo.org/docs/dev/templates/\">bu dokümanı okuyun.</a></p>"

#. Content of the 'html_llwp' (HTML) field in DocType 'Request for Quotation'
#: erpnext/buying/doctype/request_for_quotation/request_for_quotation.json
msgid "<p>In your <b>Email Template</b>, you can use the following special variables:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ update_password_link }}</code>: A link where your supplier can set a new password to log into your portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: A link to this RFQ in your supplier portal.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: The company name of your supplier.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: The contact person of your supplier.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Your full name.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Apart from these, you can access all values in this RFQ, like <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> or <code>{{ terms }}</code>.</p>"
msgstr "<p><b>E-posta Şablonunuzda</b>, aşağıdaki özel değişkenleri kullanabilirsiniz:\n"
"</p>\n"
"<ul>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ update_password_link }}</code>: Tedarikçinizin portalınıza giriş yapmak için yeni bir şifre belirleyebileceği bir bağlantı.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ portal_link }}</code>: Tedarikçi portalınızda bu Fiyat Teklifi Talebine yönlendiren bir bağlantı.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ supplier_name }}</code>: Tedarikçinizin şirket adı.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"        <li>\n"
"            <code>{{ contact.salutation }} {{ contact.last_name }}</code>: Tedarikçinizin iletişim kişisi.\n"
"        </li><li>\n"
"            <code>{{ user_fullname }}</code>: Tam adınız.\n"
"        </li>\n"
"    </ul>\n"
"<p></p>\n"
"<p>Bunların dışında, bu Fiyat Teklifi Talebindeki tüm değerlere, <code>{{ message_for_supplier }}</code> veya <code>{{ terms }}</code> gibi, erişebilirsiniz.</p>"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Gateway
#. Account'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_gateway_account/payment_gateway_account.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Thank You for being a part of {{ doc.company }}! We hope you are enjoying the service.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Please find enclosed the E Bill statement. The outstanding amount is {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; We don't want you to be spending time running around in order to pay for your Bill.<br>After all, life is beautiful and the time you have in hand should be spent to enjoy it!<br>So here are our little ways to help you get more time for life! &lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Mesaj Örneği</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; {{ doc.company }}'in bir parçası olduğunuz için teşekkür ederiz! Hizmetten keyif aldığınızı umuyoruz.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; E-Fatura ekstresini ekte bulabilirsiniz. Ödenmemiş tutar {{ doc.grand_total }}'dir.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; Faturanızı ödemek için oradan oraya koşturarak zaman harcamanızı istemiyoruz.<br>Sonuçta, hayat güzeldir ve elinizdeki zamanı tadını çıkarmak için harcamalısınız!<br>İşte hayatınıza daha fazla zaman ayırmanıza yardımcı olacak küçük yollarımız! &lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; ödeme yapmak için tıklayın &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"

#. Content of the 'Message Examples' (HTML) field in DocType 'Payment Request'
#: erpnext/accounts/doctype/payment_request/payment_request.json
msgid "<pre><h5>Message Example</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Dear {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Requesting payment for {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.grand_total }}.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; click here to pay &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
msgstr "<pre><h5>Mesaj Örneği</h5>\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt;Sevgili {{ doc.contact_person }},&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;p&gt; {{ doc.doctype }}, {{ doc.name }} için {{ doc.grand_total }}için ödeme talep ediyoruz.&lt;/p&gt;\n\n"
"&lt;a href=\"{{ payment_url }}\"&gt; ödemek için buraya tıklayın &lt;/a&gt;\n\n"
"</pre>\n"
